interpretations: For each invoice line, use the town of the customer on the invoice’s order; average `product_price` and `derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost` separately for each `(order_item_id, town)`, then average those results per town. Return towns whose ratio exceeds the equally weighted average of town ratios, with the unrounded difference

Use the customer on the order referenced by each line’s `order_item_id` to determine the town, then apply the same two stages of averaging and compare each town’s ratio with the equally weighted average of town ratios
Include a line only when its invoice’s order and its referenced order item’s order agree; use that order’s customer town, then apply the two stages of averaging and the cross-town comparison

At the `(order_item_id, town)` stage, include only lines with both a nonmissing `product_price` and a defined cost ratio in both averages; then average those results per town and compare town ratios equally

For each `(order_item_id, town)`, divide the average `derived_product_cost` by the average `derived_total_cost`, while averaging `product_price` separately; then average those item-level results per town and compare town ratios equally

After calculating the averages for each `(order_item_id, town)` and then each town, compare each town’s ratio with the overall average of the item-level ratios, weighting towns by their number of contributing order items
Treat a missing customer town as its own town group when calculating the town averages and the cross-town average
Exclude lines whose customer town is missing before calculating either stage of averages or the cross-town average
Compare each town’s ratio with the average of all invoice-line cost ratios, weighting towns by their number of contributing lines
Average price and ratio separately within each `(order_item_id, town)` group, but include an item group in the town-level averages only if both item-level averages are defined
queries:
WITH item_averages AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_item_id,
        c.town_city,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
        AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_fraction
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        town_city,
        AVG(avg_price) / NULLIF(AVG(avg_cost_fraction), 0) AS town_ratio
    FROM item_averages
    GROUP BY town_city
)
SELECT
    town_city,
    town_ratio - (SELECT AVG(town_ratio) FROM town_ratios) AS difference
FROM town_ratios
WHERE town_ratio > (SELECT AVG(town_ratio) FROM town_ratios)

WITH town_averages AS (
    SELECT c.town_city,
           AVG(ili.derived_total_cost) AS average_cost
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi
      ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
     AND oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.town_city
)
SELECT town_city
FROM town_averages
WHERE average_cost > (
    SELECT AVG(average_cost)
    FROM town_averages
)

WITH item_town_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_item_id,
        c.town_city,
        AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) / AVG(ili.product_price) AS cost_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE ili.product_price IS NOT NULL
      AND ili.product_price <> 0
      AND ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
)
SELECT
    town_city,
    AVG(cost_ratio) AS town_ratio
FROM item_town_ratios
GROUP BY town_city
ORDER BY town_ratio DESC

WITH item_town AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_item_id,
        c.town_city AS town,
        AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(AVG(ili.derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS average_product_price
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
)
SELECT
    town,
    AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio,
    AVG(average_product_price) AS average_product_price
FROM item_town
GROUP BY town
ORDER BY average_cost_ratio DESC
